propositions: container restart during in-flight code review causes premature shutdown drain timeout (45s vs 1200s review timeout), triggering fail-closed LLM-Review -1 vote that blocks backfill reconciler recovery
drain window must be sized to full review timeout (1200s) and stop_grace_period extended to 1320s to allow reviews to complete before termination
retryable coverage gaps (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) must defer voting and leave changes vote-less so backfill reconciler can retry them
review_attempts ledger tracks consecutive failures per (change_id, revision) and escalates to fail-closed -1 after RETRYABLE_GAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3) with exhaustion marker
terminal outcomes (finding, indeterminate, gate-disabled) continue to vote -1; only retryable conditions and teardown-mid-review defer voting
no-vote deferral posts nothing to Gerrit change and creates no voted table row, preserving reconciler eligibility for re-drive
